## Reservation & Handover Policies
- Zero upfront online card charge: Hirers reserve online and settle payment upon physical equipment inspection in-store.
- Verification: Valid National Identity Card (NIC), Sri Lankan Driving License, or Foreign Passport required at handover.
- Drone Compliance: Drone hirers are briefed on CAASL flight limits (under 400ft, line-of-sight, no-fly zones around military & airport installations).
